cards.card_text: Then the call goes out: "Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!"
cards.verse_text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
cards.snippet: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!

cards.card_text: Earlier it was worship at His footstool, but this time the place is different.
cards.verse_text: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
cards.snippet: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!

cards.card_text: While David's Lord sits at the LORD's right hand, the LORD says that He Himself will make the enemies of David's Lord a footstool.
cards.verse_text: The LORD said to my Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
cards.snippet: …Lord: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”

cards.card_text: Now that they've found the ark, what do they invite each other to do at His footstool?
cards.verse_text: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
cards.snippet: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.

cards.card_text: Now He speaks again, and He starts BIG: 'Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool.'
cards.verse_text: This is what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool.
cards.snippet: …what the LORD says: “Heaven is My throne, and earth is My footstool.

cards.card_text: He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth, and abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
cards.verse_text: He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.
cards.snippet: He has abandoned His footstool in the day of His anger.

cards.card_text: And not by the earth, for it is His footstool.
cards.verse_text: But I tell you not to swear at all: either by heaven, for it is God’s throne; or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
cards.snippet: …it is God’s throne; or by the earth, for it is His footstool; or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

cards.card_text: In David's psalm, someone will make the enemies of the one at the Lord's right hand a footstool for His feet.
cards.verse_text: For David himself says in the book of Psalms: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
cards.snippet: …Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’

cards.card_text: But David himself, in Psalm 110, says the Lord said to his Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”
cards.verse_text: For David did not ascend into heaven, but he himself says: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’
cards.snippet: …Lord, “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet.”’

cards.card_text: The Lord says, "Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool."
cards.verse_text: As the prophet says: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool.
cards.snippet: …the prophet says: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool.

cards.card_text: In the words Stephen quotes, the Lord says heaven is His throne and the earth is His footstool.
cards.verse_text: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool.
cards.snippet: ‘Heaven is My throne and the earth is My footstool.

cards.card_text: Then the writer asks the angel question one more time, about sitting at God's right hand and a footstool for the Son's feet.
cards.verse_text: You will roll them up like a robe; like a garment they will be changed; but You remain the same, and Your years will never end.” Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?
cards.snippet: …say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?

cards.card_text: God tells the Son to sit at His right hand until He makes the Son's ___ a footstool for His feet.
cards.verse_text: Yet to which of the angels did God ever say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?
cards.snippet: …say: “Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet”?

cards.card_text: Since that time, Jesus waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet.
cards.verse_text: Since that time, He waits for His enemies to be made a footstool for His feet,
